evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/z/d owns a Map<String, rs.z.b>, starts a duration-backed timer only when the same key is not active, can forcibly restart/remove/clear timers, reports active state and remaining milliseconds, and exposes the registry.

Both rs/Client and rs/l/d/c obtain this exact object from Launcher.f(), use key LOGIN_COOLDOWN with duration 500 ms, and proceed with login only when rs/z/d.a(String,long) successfully starts the cooldown.
Launcher constructs one rs/z/d and uses it to suppress repeated tray notifications: the notification title is the key and a 5000 ms duration must be acquired before TrayIcon.displayMessage executes.

candidates.note: CooldownManager is a conservative semantic recovery name for the shared keyed runtime cooldown registry proven by independent login and tray-notification consumers. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier. Confidence 0.997.
